title: Priya NGO v. Municipal Corporation
text: The petitioner NGO filed a public interest writ petition under Article 226 of the Constitution alleging that the Municipal Corporation was failing to provide safe drinking water to slum dwellers, violating their fundamental right to life under Article 21. The petition sought a writ of mandamus directing the Corporation to lay pipelines in identified slum areas within six months. The High Court, exercising its jurisdiction under Article 226 in a public interest matter, examines the Municipal Corporation's duty under the Constitution and municipal law. The right to clean drinking water is an aspect of the fundamental right to life. The High Court issues a writ of mandamus directing the Corporation to submit a time-bound action plan within four weeks and to complete water supply infrastructure within one year. The fundamental rights of the slum dwellers cannot be allowed to be violated for want of administrative will.
